item.subject: science
item.stem: For a school science project, Meena and Arjun discuss why life on Earth can survive. Their teacher asks: besides simply being the air around us, what does the atmosphere do that helps support life? Which statement is not correct?

options.A: It contains oxygen, which humans, animals and plants use for respiration.
options.B: It traps some of the Sun's heat, keeping Earth warm enough for water to stay liquid.
options.C: It completely blocks all heat from escaping, so Earth never cools down at night.
options.D: Its gases help keep temperatures mild enough for living things to survive.
